newsitem.title: PERU: Lima bolsa changes list of blue-chip index stocks.
newsitem.headline: Lima bolsa changes list of blue-chip index stocks.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange began using Friday a new list of 15 blue-chip stocks for its Selective Index, incorporating a new stock from a merger of breweries and adding two shares of a leading mining company.
The exchange put Buenaventura's labor and common "A" shares on the list and withdrew three stocks.

The bolsa removed Metal manufacturer Fabrica de Aluminios y Metales del Peru due to its low trading volumes and two shares of breweries involved in a merger -- Backus y Johnston and Compania Nacional de Cerveza.
Backus y Johnston, CNC and their two sister companies, Sociedad Cervecera de Trujillo SA and Cerveceria del Norte, merged at the start of 1997.

Despite the merger, the separate companies' shares continued trading until Friday when they became one share trading under the name of the new company Union de Cervecerias Peruanas Backus y Johnston SA. This stock was immediately put on the selective blue-chip list.

As well as the brewery and Buenaventura stocks, the new list of blue-chips also keeps Telefonica B, Banco de Credito, Edelnor, Holding Credicorp, Atacocha, Morococha, Southern Peru Ltd, Minsur, D'Onofrio and Cementos Lima.
